title: Simulated machine configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $q$ be an initial state, let $V$ be a Boolean input string, and let $t$ be a natural number. The associated configuration of a machine with $2k$ work tapes has the simulation state assigned to the original machine's configuration at time $t$, and uses that configuration's input-head position, work-tape contents and head positions, and output. Its additional work-tape data is formed from the visited-position sets for the original run through times $0$ to $t-1$, together with the original head positions.
hypotheses_covered: A $k$-work-tape machine with Boolean input alphabet
caveat: The supplied statement uses the constructors for configurations and marked sets without supplying their definitions, so the precise arrangement of the two groups of $k$ tapes cannot be specified from this payload alone.
